algorithm: CalibratedClassifierCV(sigmoid) over word unigram/bigram TF-IDF + LogisticRegression
evaluation_method: StratifiedGroupKFold grouped by base label and connected character n-gram similarity clusters; deterministic first fold; holdout excluded from artifact fitting

split.method: StratifiedGroupKFold by base label; character n-gram similarity groups

metric_scope: Grouped holdout only; not the robustness/challenge set and not a claim of general accuracy.

benchmark_context.benchmark_metric: 0.977 macro F1 in results/model_comparison.json grouped holdout; separate comparison experiment
benchmark_context.reason: Retain the existing probability-producing calibrated Logistic Regression production baseline; the Linear SVM comparison candidate does not expose calibrated probabilities, which the gameplay confidence UI consumes. This clean run does not automatically promote a different model.
